# Kevin Wolf's Devtools

Collection of opinionated developer tools used across multiple projects.

## Plugins

Claude Code plugins with reusable skills.

| Plugin | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| [base](./claude-plugins/base) | Base tooling for any TypeScript project |
| [web](./claude-plugins/web) | Skills for web development with TanStack Start, shadcn/ui, and Base UI |
| [convex](./claude-plugins/convex) | Skills for Convex backend development with zodvex and Better Auth |

## Configs

Shareable configurations for development tools.

| Package | Description |
|---------|-------------|

## Development

### Local Setup

```bash
git clone https://github.com/kvnwolf/devtools.git
cd devtools
bun install
```

### Scripts

| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `bun run lint` | Run Biome linter |
| `bun run unused` | Run knip for unused dependencies |
| `bun run validate` | Run lint and unused dependency check |
| `bun run update` | Interactive dependency updates |
| `bun run pre-commit` | Lint and fix staged files |

## License

[MIT](LICENSE)

# Base Plugin

Base tooling for any TypeScript project.

## Installation

Add the marketplace:

```
/plugin marketplace add kvnwolf/devtools
```

Install the plugin:

```
/plugin install base@kvnwolf-devtools
```

## Skills

| Skill | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `setup-base` | Bootstrap a new TypeScript project with biome, t3-env, knip, tsgo, and vitest |
| `environment-variables` | Patterns for managing and validating environment variables using t3-env |
| `commit` | Sync documentation, commit, push, and open a pull request |
| `create-skill` | Write, structure, and improve agent skills following best practices |
| `create-test` | Write automated tests following TDD principles with Vitest |

## Hooks

| Event | Matcher | Description |
|-------|---------|-------------|
| UserPromptSubmit | — | Reminds the agent to evaluate installed skills before proceeding |
| SubagentStart | — | Reminds subagents and teammates to evaluate installed skills |
| PreToolUse | Bash | Strips `git -C <path>` so git commands run in the current directory |
| PreToolUse | Bash | Replaces `npm`/`npx` with `bun`/`bunx` |
| PostToolUse | Write\|Edit | Runs biome lint on edited files |
| PostToolUse | Write\|Edit | Runs vitest related on edited files, blocking on failure |
files.claude-plugins/web/README.md:
# Web Plugin

Skills for web development with TanStack Start, shadcn/ui, and Base UI.

## Installation

Add the marketplace:

```
/plugin marketplace add kvnwolf/devtools
```

Install the plugin:

```
/plugin install web@kvnwolf-devtools
```

## Skills

| Skill | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `setup-tanstack-start` | Bootstrap a new web project with TanStack Start, TanStack Query, Tailwind CSS, and shadcn/ui |
| `agent-browser` | Browser automation for navigating pages, filling forms, taking screenshots, and extracting data |
| `tanstack-form` | Build type-safe, accessible forms with TanStack Form and Base UI Field |
| `polymorphic-components` | Implement the render prop pattern with Base UI's useRender hook |
| `create-component-test` | Write component tests using Vitest Browser Mode with Playwright |
| `create-e2e-test` | Write end-to-end tests with Playwright Test |

## Hooks

| Event | Matcher | Description |
|-------|---------|-------------|
| PreToolUse | Bash | Replaces direct `agent-browser` with `bunx agent-browser@latest` and adds `--headed` to `open` |

# Convex

Claude Code plugin for working with [Convex](https://convex.dev) backend projects.

## Installation

```
/plugin marketplace add kvnwolf/devtools
/plugin install convex@kvnwolf-devtools
```

## Skills

| Skill | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `setup-convex` | Add Convex with zodvex to an existing TanStack Start project |
| `create-convex-table` | Define Convex tables using zodvex's zodTable with Zod schemas |
| `create-convex-query` | Write Zod-validated Convex queries and consume them from React |
| `create-convex-mutation` | Write Zod-validated Convex mutations with optimistic updates |
| `create-convex-action` | Write Zod-validated Convex actions for external API calls |
| `create-convex-test` | Write tests for Convex functions using convex-test |
| `setup-convex-auth` | Add Better Auth authentication to a TanStack Start + Convex project |
| `setup-convex-auth-local-install` | Migrate Better Auth to a local install for full schema control |
| `setup-convex-auth-github` | Configure GitHub as a social login provider for Better Auth + Convex |
| `setup-convex-auth-email-otp` | Add Better Auth email OTP plugin for passwordless sign-in |
| `setup-convex-auth-organizations` | Add Better Auth organization plugin for multi-tenant support |
| `setup-convex-auth-google` | Configure Google as a social login provider for Better Auth + Convex |
| `setup-convex-resend` | Add Resend transactional email sending to a Convex project |
